description: This file contains definitions for classes and functions related to document management in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including directory and file handling, content indexing, and configuration wizard.

classes.name: node_class
classes.description: Represents a URI node, handling directory and file navigation, translation, and path management.

classes.name: document_directory
classes.description: Model for managing document directories, including creation, duplication, validation, and resource path generation.

classes.name: document_directory_node
classes.description: Inherits process.node, adds a link to a document directory.

classes.name: document_directory_content_type
classes.description: Model for content types within directories, such as file extensions.

classes.name: document_directory_content
classes.description: Model for content files within directories, including PDF processing and report generation.

classes.name: ir_action_report_xml
classes.description: Extension of report actions, linking reports to models.

classes.name: document_file
classes.description: Extends ir.attachment to handle file storage, indexing, and duplication checks.

classes.name: document_configuration_wizard
classes.description: Wizard for configuring server and directory settings, including IP detection and resource setup.

methods.name: random_name
methods.description: Generates a random string of 10 ASCII letters.

methods.name: create_directory
methods.description: Creates a new directory with a random name in the specified path.
